observations: [verify] quote API: https://docs.near-intents.org/api-reference/oneclick/request-a-swap-quote.md — POST /v0/quote; required body fields dry, swapType, slippageTolerance, originAsset, depositType, destinationAsset, amount, refundTo, refundType, recipient, recipientType, deadline; auth header X-API-Key; amount is an integer string in base units

[verify] dry=true is the documented preview option: "simulate the quote request without generating a deposit address or initiating the swap process"; depositAddress, timeWhenInactive and deadline are omitted from the response

[verify] 27 Oct changelog: https://docs.near-intents.org/changelog/entries/2026-10-27-1click-confidential — API unchanged; swapDetails.nearTxHashes lists the public shield and unshield; the swap settles on the NEAR Private Shard and has no public NEAR hash; silent on whether recipientType INTENTS credits a public intents.near balance (that is K2′ part B, T2, human)
probe fields: swapType FLEX_INPUT, depositType ORIGIN_CHAIN, recipientType INTENTS, refundType ORIGIN_CHAIN, slippageTolerance 100 bps, deadline now+60 min, dry true
recipient = inv-1.<OWED_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID>; refundTo = PAYER_EVM_ADDRESS (public payer address; PAYER_EVM_KEY is never read)
destination asset = the origin asset Intents token ID (spec 2a-2), i.e. the same asset; no deposit is ever sent, no /v0/deposit/submit call, no status polling
auth header: 1Click API accepts JWT token via Authorization header (returns 201 Created); X-API-Key with JWT returns 401 Invalid token

caveat (2026-10-27 review): the recipient is a TESTNET name (inv-1.<OWED_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID>, ends in .testnet) and every probe was still ACCEPTED — a dry quote evidently does NOT validate the recipient on-chain nor the live floor. The floor recorded here is a DRY-QUOTE floor only; the live floor is confirmed only by K2' part B (human, T2). The recipient for part B must be the mainnet inv-1.<owner> name, which the human has not created yet.
